user.title: Package Keeper
user.description: Saves the YAML packages proposed by an AI from a sidebar panel (administrators only), with a configuration check and automatic rollback. Package Keeper only writes to the packages folder: it never modifies configuration.yaml.

data_description.admin_notify_target: A notify.mobile_app_* service or a notify entity from the Companion app. Pre-filled with the phone already chosen in another SDR integration (Entity Inventory, Sentinel Report…), if any.
data_description.notify_changes: Sends a notification to the admin phone each time a package is saved, deleted or restored. An automatic rollback is always notified.
data_description.backups_kept: Older versions are deleted beyond this number. Backups are stored in /config/.package_keeper/backups.

error.invalid_target: Enter a notify service or entity, e.g. notify.mobile_app_my_phone.
